verdict.rationale: Flagsmith ships an official MCP server so a user's AI assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options and release workflows on their behalf. Natural-language operation is therefore possible, but only through a third-party assistant that does the language interpretation; the evidence shows no natural-language interface built into Flagsmith itself. missing for 10: native natural-language command interface in the product, documented example prompts or NL workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Your assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options, and release workflows on your behalf — in a human-in-the-loop IDE session, or fully automated in a CI/CD pipeline.
The Flagsmith MCP Server gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to the Flagsmith Admin API through the Model Context Protocol
